personal.name: Jessica Helms
personal.researchFocus: Bioinformaticist specializing in spatial transcriptomics and multimodal integration of high-dimensional tissue data. Research interests center on the molecular and structural remodeling of the human peripheral nervous system in pain pathology, integrating computational, cellular, and imaging approaches.

education.degree: Master of Science in Bioinformatics and Computational Biology

research.title: Research Technician
research.institution: Washington University in St. Louis – McDonnell Genome Institute, FIVE Lab
responsibilities: Culture and differentiate iPSC-derived neurons and glial lines for peripheral nerve modeling
Integrate spatial transcriptomic (Visium HD, Xenium) and proteomic (Akoya CODEX) datasets
Develop Python pipelines for transcript-to-polygon mapping, coordinate alignment, and ROI-based quantification
Apply SAHI and YOLOv12 for segmentation and immune marker detection
Collaborate to construct a spatial-omics atlas for human neuromas
